Settings.QueryText: SELECT DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.Ref AS Ref, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.Number AS Number, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.Date AS Date, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.Posted AS Posted, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.Hotel AS Hotel, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.ParentDoc AS ParentDoc, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.Room AS Room, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.InterfaceType AS InterfaceType, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.RoomInterfaceType AS RoomInterfaceType, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.Remarks AS Remarks, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.MessageDateTime AS MessageDateTime, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.MessageIsDelivered AS MessageIsDelivered, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.MessageDeliveryDateTime AS MessageDeliveryDateTime, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.Author AS Author, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.CancellationAuthor AS CancellationAuthor, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.CancellationDate AS CancellationDate, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.IsProcessed AS IsProcessed, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.IsCanceled AS IsCanceled, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.Message AS Message, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.CancellationMessage AS CancellationMessage, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.PointInTime AS PointInTime, CASE WHEN DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.RoomInterfaceType.InterfaceType = VALUE(Enum.InterfaceTypes.Internet) THEN 2 WHEN DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.RoomInterfaceType.InterfaceType = VALUE(Enum.InterfaceTypes.Minibar) THEN 3 WHEN DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.RoomInterfaceType.InterfaceType = VALUE(Enum.InterfaceTypes.Phone) THEN 1 WHEN DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.RoomInterfaceType.InterfaceType = VALUE(Enum.InterfaceTypes.TV) THEN 0 END AS InterfaceTypeIcon, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.PeriodOfStayExtensionIsRequested AS PeriodOfStayExtensionIsRequested, DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus.GuestNameChangeIsRequested AS GuestNameChangeIsRequested FROM Document.RoomInterfaceStatus AS DocumentRoomInterfaceStatus
